description: Org-scoped pre-registered trial plans: regime, primary metric, margin, the frozen sample plan (pre-registration), models, status (registered/concluded/voided) and the concluding verdict id. Read-only. Response is envelope-shaped: every numeric leaf is a MeasuredValue {value, ci_low, ci_high, method, data_through}. ci fields are null unless the source payload carries a real confidence interval — never fabricated. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.
name: metrx_get_trials
title: Get Trial Plans
